strengths: Workspace resolves all 4 required packages (protocol, relay, mcp-server, runner-esp32) via pnpm-workspace.yaml 'packages/*' with matching importers in pnpm-lock.yaml
Vitest configured at root (vitest.config.ts) with node environment and a real smoke test (vitest.smoke.test.ts) asserting process.versions.node
Node 22 engine constraint enforced (package.json engines.node '>=22') and pinned packageManager pnpm@10.6.5
Strict, modern tsconfig.base.json (strict, NodeNext, noUnusedLocals/Parameters, isolatedModules) provides a solid shared baseline
onlyBuiltDependencies scoped to better-sqlite3 avoids broad postinstall trust; no kareema/opt paths touched anywhere

issues.description: mcp-server declares bin 'agentpair' -> ./src/cli.ts and main ./src/index.ts, and runner-esp32 declares main ./src/index.ts, but no src/ files exist yet. Acceptable for a scaffold skeleton (files land in T2/T7), noted only as an observation.
